sources.title: Vogtle Unit 4 begins commercial operation
sources.note: Completed large-reactor project, not an SMR. Cost and schedule history; electricity is now being generated.

sources.title: Carbon Free Power Project updated price target
sources.note: US$89/MWh was a project target with financing assumptions, not an operating plant price.

sources.title: Carbon Free Power Project termination
sources.note: Insufficient expected customer subscription. A failed project does not prove every SMR must fail.

sources.title: Darlington SMR: budget and schedule
sources.note: C$6.1B first unit plus C$1.6B shared infrastructure; C$20.9B programme. First grid connection targeted for end-2030.

sources.title: Darlington New Nuclear Project
sources.note: Project investment and intended output; not completed operating economics.

sources.title: Darlington licensing and construction status
sources.note: Construction permission is not an operating licence. Status checked September 13.

sources.title: V.C. Summer feasibility milestones
sources.note: Completion feasibility for unfinished Units 2 and 3. Existing Unit 1 is a separate operating asset.

sources.title: Nuclear energy agreements for AI
sources.note: Up to 6.6 GW by 2035 includes new and existing nuclear, not a near-term delivered SMR fleet.

sources.title: The Path to a New Era for Nuclear Energy
sources.note: Deployment scenarios depend on financing, policy, construction and cost reductions.

sources.title: Renewable Power Generation Costs in 2025
sources.note: New utility-scale solar global weighted LCOE: US$44/MWh in 2025. Not a rooftop quote or an all-hour firm power price.

sources.title: Lithium-ion technology improvement and cost decline
sources.note: Historical cell prices, not the installed retail price of a complete home system.

sources.title: Drivers of lithium-ion battery cost decline
sources.note: Research, scale and manufacturing improvements; future prices remain uncertain.

sources.title: Queued Up: 2026 edition
sources.note: Proposed transmission-interconnection projects, not all built or ready. GW is power, not storage duration.

sources.title: Permitting and inspection for rooftop solar
sources.note: Local permits, inspections and utility processes still apply to rooftop projects.

sources.title: Chernobyl health assessment
sources.note: The up-to-4,000 figure is a projected eventual toll among higher-exposed groups, not an observed death count.

sources.title: Fukushima report: questions and answers
sources.note: No documented resident health effects directly attributable to radiation; distinguish displacement and psychological harms.

sources.title: Abandoned uranium mines cleanup
sources.note: More than 500 abandoned mines on and near Navajo Nation. Legacy is not all attributable to proposed SMRs.

sources.title: Solar energy and storage basics
sources.note: Storage shifts energy. Design, duration, losses and operating purpose matter.

sources.title: The road to resilience with rooftop solar
sources.note: Grid-tied solar normally disconnects during outages; appropriate equipment enables backup.

sources.title: Six million solar installations
sources.note: 97% residential share; approximate installation-to-household proxy, not an exact homeowner census.

sources.title: Installed home-battery prices
sources.note: US$15,647 typical 13.5 kWh installed benchmark before incentives; not a Prosper quote; retrofits can cost more.

sources.title: CAD per USD: September 11, 2026
sources.note: C$1.3866 per US$1, used only to align currencies in the capital-allocation illustration.

sources.title: California virtual-power-plant dispatch test
sources.note: 535 MW average for two hours on July 29, 2025; operator-supplied telemetry, not continuous output. Direct PDF may restrict automated access.

sources.title: Virtual power plants
sources.note: Aggregation and compensation models. Broad forecasts include flexible loads, not only batteries.

sources.title: Household Energy Affordability
sources.note: Global household electricity spending exceeded US$1T in 2024. Not a VPP revenue forecast.

sources.title: Cancer mortality and nuclear-plant proximity
sources.note: County-level proximity association; no direct radiation measurements and no causal conclusion.

sources.title: INWORKS nuclear-worker cohort
sources.note: Dose association in monitored workers. A per-gray risk slope is not a blanket percentage risk for residents.

sources.title: Childhood leukaemia near German plants
sources.note: Under-five leukaemia association within 5 km; radiation causation was not established.

sources.title: Childhood cancer near British nuclear installations
sources.publisher: Davies et al., International Journal of Epidemiology
sources.note: No elevated incidence of studied childhood cancers in the 1995–2016 population. Important contrary evidence.

sources.title: Nuclear accidents and cancer
sources.note: Radiation risks and accident-related evidence; do not generalize accident dose to routine operation.

sources.title: Why the cancer-risk study effort ended
sources.note: Documented research cancellation; not evidence that positive findings were secretly suppressed.

sources.title: Residential energy-storage safety
sources.note: Certification, thermal-runaway testing, installation and applicable codes matter.

sources.title: Solar-panel recycling
sources.note: Solar has end-of-life obligations too; neither solar nor batteries are impact-free.

sources.title: High-level radioactive waste
sources.note: Spent fuel requires shielding, management and long-term disposal arrangements.

sources.title: Profitable Emissions-Reducing Energy Storage
sources.publisher: Daniel J. Olsen & Daniel S. Kirschen
sources.note: Charging and dispatch choices determine operational emissions; economic arbitrage is not automatically carbon reduction.

sources.title: UAMPS describes its earlier SMR price and schedule
sources.note: Contemporaneous account of UAMPS leadership discussing the US$58/MWh target and 2029–2030 schedule.

sources.title: SMR deployment and operating examples
sources.note: Documents commercial operation at Akademik Lomonosov and HTR-PM. These examples do not establish U.S. household economics.
